en.heroLede: A single-player roguelite deckbuilder. Take up the lantern, build a deck of glass, and walk east toward a door that has never opened.

c1.title: One fire. Six pieces.
c1.alt: Six shards of emberglass bursting away from one fire
c1.p1: Before the first night there was one fire. Then it was cut into six, and the pieces were scattered along a road that runs from the western edge of the world to a door no one has opened.
c1.p2: The shards burn on somewhere in the dark — in a forest that grows on ash, beneath the water of a city that stopped to wait, in a court of black glass where no fire burns. At the western end of the road, a single hearth has burned since that first night.
c1.p3: Carry it east. Break what stands in your way. Bring the fire home.
c1.quote: “A fire was cut into six pieces and scattered along the road.”

c2.title: A fire in the far west
c2.narr: You wake at a hearth on the western edge of the world. The hall is old and the stone is warm. Someone has kept this fire burning since the first night — and kept a place beside it for you.

quotes.q: “Take your time. The road isn’t going anywhere.”

c3.title: It burns what you carry
c3.narr: Before you leave, you are given a lantern that others carried before you. On the road ahead, its light will be the only light that is yours — and it is always hungry.

quotes.q: “It burns what you carry.”
“The road runs east. At its end stands a sealed door. Bring back the six shards of emberglass, and it will open.”

c4.title: The Vigil begins
c4.narr: The door of the hall opens onto the dark before dawn. The road runs level and east, past the last lamp, into country where the glass is alive — and does not want to be broken.

quotes.q: “You take up the lantern and step out. The long road runs east, and the sky is not yet light.”
“Behind you, the fire is still burning.”
“The Vigil begins.”

c4.bearerText: Glass honed to a killing edge. Strikes, shatters, and turns broken facets into fuel — a blade that cuts a road through any night.

c5.title: The Ashen Woods
c5.narr: A forest that grows on ash. Spores hang in the lamplight like slow snow, pale masks lie half-buried under the trees, and old monuments stand thick where the road begins. Something has prayed here for a very long time. Nothing has answered.

quotes.q: “Two lanterns burning side by side. The flames are fresh. Whose?”
“They pray to the ash. The ash answers no one.”

c5.bossLbl: At the heart of the woods

c6.title: The Hollow Lamplighter
c6.narr: On the Unlit Way, an old man waits beside the road with a lantern that holds no flame. He studies every face that passes. Five times he will stop you, and five times he will name a price.

quotes.q: “An old man sits by the road, holding a lantern. There is no flame in it.”
“Oil can be shared. Flame cannot. Flame you carry to the end yourself.”
“He steps aside and lifts the hollow lantern toward the east, as if to light the way. There is no light in it. He lifts it all the same.”

c7.title: Strangers on the road
c7.narr: Not everything on the road is glass that wants breaking. A merchant in an eyeless mask trades by lantern light. A skeleton deals cards to anyone who will sit. A knight rests against a burned tree with something to give. A smiling trader weighs hearts against gold. Each of them wants something. Few of them say what.
c7.quote: “Gold for glory, stranger. Everything’s fair-priced — for the doomed.”

strangers: “One throw, stranger. Fortune loves the reckless.”
A grinning skeleton in a wide hat deals cards beside a roadside fire, an empty chair facing him
He holds out a shard of amber. He will not need it now.
A knight of cracked stained glass slumped against a burned tree, holding out a glowing amber crystal
He pays well for what you will not be needing.
A thin trader in a white mask holding brass scales with a red glass heart on one pan

c8.title: The Sunken City
c8.narr: Halfway along the road, a whole city stopped to wait for the door. The water rose around its waiting and never went down. Its people still stand at their windows beneath the tide, and a light drifts through the drowned streets — a light that leads no one anywhere.

quotes.q: “The city stayed to wait. So did the water.”
“There’s a light under the water. It leads to nothing — it only leads people.”

c9.title: The Obsidian Court
c9.narr: Before the door stands a court of black glass. No fire is lit there. Its courtiers sit in starlight and have sat too long; broken halos lie where they fell, and something watches every step you take toward the throne.

quotes.q: “No fire in the court. They sit in starlight, and have sat too long.”
“Broken halos on the ground. No one gathers them.”
“The nearer the door, the more of them. All seated.”

c10.title: The Eternal Sovereign
c10.narr: A masked king holds the throne before the last door, crowned in violet glass, a broken halo at his back. Somewhere on the road behind you, a merchant is selling a lantern with no flame.

quotes.q: “The Sovereign is a mask worn before the last door.”
“Cold glass. No wick. The merchant will not say who left it.”

c11.title: There is a sealed door beyond the crown.
c11.narr: Six shards. One lantern. One road. What waits on the other side is not written here. It is written on the road.

s.title: How the pilgrimage works
s.intro: Three loops turn inside one another: the walk across a pilgrimage, the turn inside a fight, and the slow change of a deck and its flame. This is how each of them works.

loop.title: Every step is a choice
loop.body: A pilgrimage crosses three acts. Each act is a map of fifteen waystones woven from six paths, and you choose every step: which fights to take, which mysteries to risk, when to rest and when to press on.
loop.alt: Diagram: an ember chooses one route across a branching map of waystones, past a fight, an unknown, an elite and a rest site, to the boss

bullets.p: A safer road now can mean a harder one later. Elites guard the best rewards.
hide what they hold, but pay a bounty to whoever lights them.
The last waystone of each act is always a rest site: heal, or reforge one card.

loop.cap: Act I · the journey map · in game
loop.shotAlt: The journey map of the Ashen Woods, with waystones along a river gorge

turn.title: Five cards, three candles, one lantern
turn.body: Energy refills every turn. Embers stay. Each card you feed to the lantern is gone for the rest of the fight — so every turn asks what you can afford to burn.
turn.alt: In-game footage of one turn against an Alpha Duskfang: a Strike chips a facet, a Defend is kindled into the lantern, the Lantern Art breaks the glass, and the foe acts on its shown intent
steps: Three candles of Energy pay for what you play.
Cards spend Energy to hit, guard and afflict.
Once a turn, feed any card to the lantern for one Ember.
Once a turn, spend Embers on a Lantern Art.
Every foe shows its intent before it acts.
turn.cap: One turn, recorded from the game · Act I, Alpha Duskfang

glass.title: Chip. Crack. Shatter.
glass.body: Every creature is glass with a facet gauge: four facets for most foes, more for elites and bosses. An unblocked hit chips one facet. Fill the gauge and the glass shatters.
glass.alt: In-game footage, slowed: the Lantern Art and a Strike break the Alpha Duskfang, which is Staggered and gains two Cracked

bullets.p: A shattered foe skips its next action, so timing the break against a big intent is the best defence there is.
Every shatter spills two Embers. Glass you break pays for the Art that breaks the next one.
Each break makes the next one harder: the foe’s facet gauge grows by one.

flame.title: The flame reads your deck
flame.body: Before each fight the lantern weighs the coloured glass in your deck and settles on a flame. It never watches how you play — only what you carry — and the fight keeps that flame to the end.
flame.alt: Diagram on the game’s own numbers: as one colour comes to lead the deck’s coloured glass, the lantern goes from Kindling and Soot to Steady and True, holding more Embers and paying less for its Art
flame.purLbl: The leading way’s share of coloured glass
tiers: Fewer than five coloured cards. The plain lantern: 9 Embers, Arts at full price.
Three coloured cards · too few to read
No way leads (45% or less). Leaks 1 Ember a turn; Arts cost 1 more.
One way holds 60%. Holds 4 more Embers; the first Ember each turn burns 2 brighter.
One way holds 75%. Everything Steady gives, and Arts cost 2 less.

bullets.h: Clear glass is fuel, not noise.
bullets.p: Cards with no colour never dim the flame. Cutting off-colour glass steadies it.
Some cards carry a rider that resolves only while the lantern burns their colour, Steady or True.
The Duskblade’s glass leans three ways. Draft into one and the flame turns its colour.

g.title: Build a deck of glass
g.intro: Every card is a slab of glass, and every rarity has its own finish. Move your pointer across a card — or tilt your phone — and the light moves with you.
g.veilSub: Some glass is not written here.

zh-Hant.heroLede: 一款單人牌組構築冒險。提起燈，組一副琉璃牌，向東走向一扇從未打開的門。每一次啟程，路都不一樣。

c1.title: 一團火，六片碎璃。
c1.alt: 六片燼璃由一團火中迸散
c1.p1: 在第一夜之前，世上只有一團火。後來它被裁成六片，散落在一條長路上——那條路由世界的西端，一直通往一扇從未有人打開的門。
c1.p2: 那些碎璃仍在黑暗中燃燒：在長於灰燼上的樹林裏，在一座留下來等待、終被水淹沒的城底下，在一座無火燃燒的黑曜王庭之中。長路的西端，有一爐火由第一夜燒到現在。
c1.p3: 帶着它向東走。打碎擋路之物。把火帶回家。
c1.quote: 「一團火被裁成六片，散落於路。」

c2.title: 極西之火
c2.narr: 你在世界西端的一爐火旁醒來。大廳古老，石頭溫暖。有人由第一夜起一直守着這爐火——也在火旁替你留了一個位置。

quotes.q: 「慢慢來。路不會走掉。」

c3.title: 它燒的是你帶着的東西
c3.narr: 臨行前，有人遞給你一盞前人提過的燈。前面的路上，只有這點光是屬於你的——而它永遠都餓。

quotes.q: 「它燒的是你帶着的東西。」
「路向東，盡頭有一道封門。尋回六片燼璃，門便會開。」

c4.title: 守夜開始了
c4.narr: 大廳的門向着黎明前的黑暗打開。長路平直向東，越過最後一盞燈，通往一片琉璃都活着、而且不願被打碎的土地。

quotes.q: 「你提起燈，推門而出。長路向東，天未亮。」
「身後，爐火仍亮着。」
「守夜開始了。」

c4.bearerText: 琉璃磨成殺伐之鋒。揮斬、碎裂，再以破碎璃面化作薪火——任何長夜皆可劈開前路。

c5.title: 灰燼樹林
c5.narr: 一片長在灰燼上的樹林。孢子在燈光中緩緩飄落，像遲來的雪；蒼白的面具半埋在樹下；長路起點的紀念碑立得密密麻麻。這裏有人祈禱了很久很久，從來沒有回應。

quotes.q: 「兩盞燈並亮。火是新的。誰點的？」
「他們向灰祈禱。灰不應人。」

c5.mob: 本幕代表 · 墓園守衛

c6.title: 空燈掌燈人
c6.narr: 未燃之路上，一個老人坐在路旁，手裏的燈沒有火。他細看每一張經過的臉。他會攔下你五次，每一次都開出一個價錢。

quotes.q: 「路上坐着一個提燈的老人。燈是空的，沒有火。」
「油可以分，火不能分。火要自己帶到最後。」
「他讓開路，提起空燈，向東照了照——燈中沒有光；他仍是照了。」

c7.title: 路上的陌生人
c7.narr: 路上並非每樣東西都是等着被打碎的琉璃。戴無眼面具的商人在燈下買賣；骷髏向每個肯坐下的人發牌；騎士靠着燒焦的樹，手裏有東西要給你；含笑的商販用秤去量心與黃金。他們各有所求，很少人說出口。
c7.quote: 「黃金換榮耀，異鄉人。就算你命定殞落——價錢仍然公道。」

strangers: 「只擲一次，陌生人。命運偏愛不顧一切的人。」
戴寬邊帽的骷髏在路邊火旁發牌，對面放着一張空椅
他遞出一片琥珀。他已經用不着了。
裂紋琉璃騎士靠在燒焦的樹下，遞出一塊發光的琥珀晶體
你用不着的東西，他出價很高。
戴白面具的瘦削商人提着銅秤，一邊秤盤上是紅色琉璃心

c8.title: 沉沒之城
c8.narr: 在長路中段，整座城停下來等那扇門。水在它的等待中漲起，再沒有退去。城中的人仍站在潮水下的窗前，一點光在被淹沒的街道間游走——那點光不引任何人到任何地方。

quotes.q: 「這座城留下來等。水，也留下來。」
「水下有光。那光不引路，只引人。」

c9.title: 黑曜王庭
c9.narr: 門前是一座黑色琉璃的王庭。那裏不點火。朝臣坐在星光裏，坐了太久；斷了的光環落在原地。你向王座走的每一步，都有東西在看。

quotes.q: 「庭中無火。他們坐在星光裏，坐了太久。」
「斷了的光環落在地上，無人拾起。」
「越近門，人越多。全部坐着。」

c9.mob: 本幕代表 · 守望之眼

c10.title: 永恆君王
c10.narr: 一位戴面具的君王佔據最後那扇門前的王座，頭戴紫色琉璃王冠，身後是一圈破碎的光環。在你身後的路上，某個商人正在出售一盞沒有火焰的燈。

quotes.q: 「永恆君王，只是門前披上的一副面具。」
「冰冷琉璃。沒有燈芯。商人不肯說是誰留下它。」

c11.title: 王冠之後，有一扇封印之門。
c11.narr: 六片燼璃，一盞燈，一條路。門的另一邊是甚麼，這裏沒有寫。它寫在路上。

s.title: 朝聖之路如何運轉
s.intro: 三個循環一層套一層：一次朝聖的長行、一場戰鬥裏的每個回合，以及牌組與火焰慢慢的變化。以下逐一說明。

loop.title: 每一步都是選擇
loop.body: 一次朝聖橫越三幕。每一幕都是一張由十五座路碑、六條路線交織而成的地圖，每一步都由你決定：迎哪一場戰鬥，冒哪一次險，何時休息，何時前進。
loop.alt: 示意圖：一點餘燼在分岔的路碑地圖上選定一條路，經過戰鬥、未知事件、菁英與休息處，直抵首領

bullets.p: 此刻走得安穩，之後可能更難。菁英守着最好的獎賞。
隱藏所藏之物，但點亮它的人可得賞金。

bullets.h: 每個首領之前都有一爐火。
bullets.p: 每一幕最後一座路碑必是休息處：回復生命，或重鑄一張牌。

loop.cap: 第一幕 · 旅程地圖 · 遊戲畫面
loop.shotAlt: 灰燼樹林的旅程地圖，路碑沿峽谷河流分佈

turn.title: 五張牌，三支燭，一盞燈
turn.body: 能量每回合回滿，餘燼卻會留下。每一張餵給提燈的牌，在本場戰鬥中都不會再回來——所以每個回合都在問：你燒得起甚麼？
turn.alt: 對陣暮牙首領的一個回合遊戲實錄：打擊琢去一格璃面，防禦被燃燼進提燈，提燈術打碎琉璃，敵人按顯示的意圖行動
steps: 三支能量燭火支付你打出的牌。
花費能量去攻擊、格擋與削弱。
每回合一次，把任意一張牌餵給提燈，得一點餘燼。
每回合一次，花費餘燼施展提燈術。
每個敵人行動前都會顯示意圖。
turn.cap: 由遊戲錄下的一個回合 · 第一幕，暮牙首領

glass.title: 琢擊。裂開。碎裂。
glass.body: 每一隻生物都是琉璃，身上有一道璃面量表：大多數敵人四格，菁英與首領更多。每一下未被格擋的攻擊琢去一格。量表填滿，琉璃便碎裂。
glass.alt: 放慢的遊戲實錄：提燈術與一記打擊打碎暮牙首領，牠陷入踉蹌並獲得兩層裂痕
tags: 踉蹌 · 失去下一次行動

bullets.h: 碎裂就是贏回一個回合。
bullets.p: 碎裂的敵人會跳過下一次行動；在它蓄勢重擊之前打碎它，就是最好的防守。
每次碎裂都會濺出兩點餘燼。今次打碎的琉璃，替下一次碎裂的提燈術付賬。
每碎一次，下一次便更難：敵人的璃面量表多一格。

flame.title: 火焰讀懂你的牌組
flame.body: 每場戰鬥之前，提燈會衡量你牌組中的有色琉璃，定下一種火焰。它從不看你怎樣出牌——只看你帶着甚麼——而整場戰鬥都維持那一種火焰。
flame.alt: 按遊戲實際數值繪製的示意圖：當一種顏色在有色琉璃中佔優，提燈由「燃」與「塵」變成「定」與「真」，容納更多餘燼，提燈術也更便宜
flame.purLbl: 領先之道佔有色琉璃的比例
tiers: 有色牌少於五張。普通的提燈：容納 9 點餘燼，提燈術原價。
三張有色牌 · 未足以判讀
沒有一道領先（45% 或以下）。每回合流失 1 點餘燼；提燈術貴 1 點。
一道佔 60%。多容納 4 點餘燼；每回合第一點餘燼額外多 2。
一道佔 75%。擁有「定」的一切，提燈術再便宜 2 點。

bullets.h: 透明琉璃是燃料，不是雜音。
bullets.p: 沒有顏色的牌從不令火焰變暗；剔走別色的琉璃，火焰便更穩。
部分卡牌附有額外效果，只在提燈燃着其顏色（定或真）時生效。

bullets.h: 道路是找到的，不是選的。
bullets.p: 暮刃的琉璃傾向三條道路。選牌時走進其中一條，火焰便會換上它的顏色。

g.title: 組一副琉璃牌
g.intro: 每張牌都是一片琉璃，每種稀有度都有自己的質感。把指標移過一張牌——或傾斜手機——光便隨你移動。

傾盡提燈：每花費 1 點餘燼，獲得 3 點護光。燃燼。

name: Totality
全蝕
text: Deal @14@ damage, then double the enemy's Cracked.
造成 @14@ 點傷害，然後令該敵人的裂痕層數加倍。

name: Hex
咒印
text: Unplayable. At the end of your turn, lose 1 HP if this is in your hand. Refuses the fire.
無法打出。若此牌留在手中，你的回合結束時失去 1 點生命。此牌拒火。

name: Banked Fire
封火
text: Gain 1 Ember. If you win this fight, carry your lantern's Embers into the next fight.
獲得 1 點餘燼。若本場戰鬥獲勝，提燈的餘燼會保留至下一場戰鬥。
